newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil coffee estimate above 25 mln bags - trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil coffee estimate above 25 mln bags - trade.

text.p: Private consultant Leon Yallouz has reduced his forecast for the 1997/98 Brazilian coffee crop but still sees a harvest above 25 million 60-kg bags, said a trader who has seen a report sent out by Yallouz.
"It's a high figure. It is below his first estimate but it's above 25 million bags," the trader said.
Yallouz, who used to be coffee crop forecaster for U.S Agriculture Department, was unavailable for comment.
Other traders in Brazil said that they had heard the latest forecast was in the region of 27.5 million bags.
Within Brazil, the main consensus among the trade has been of a crop of up to 23 million bags. Producers, however, are expecting a a harvest of around 20 million bags.
